title: Ducati North America: CABLE TIE (396 affected)
summary: DUCATI IS RECALLING CERTAIN MODEL YEAR 2010 MULTISTRADA 1200 MOTORCYCLES.  THE THROTTLE CABLES MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE UPPER EDGE OF THE RADIATOR DURING NORMAL OPERATION OF THE MOTORCYCLE.  THIS SITUATION COULD CAUSE THE THROTTLE CABLES TO BECOME CHAFED BY THE RADIATOR RESULTING IN DAMAGE TO THE MOTORCYCLE AND A POTENTIAL HAZARD TO THE RIDER.

title: Ducati North America: CENTER STAND SCREWS (495 affected)

THIS SITUATION COULD CAUSE THE CENTER STAND TO POSSIBLY BECOME DISPLACED FROM ITS INTENDED MOUNTING POSITION RESULTING IN DAMAGE TO THE MOTORCYCLE AND A POTENTIAL HAZARD TO THE RIDER.

title: Ducati North America: STEERING HEAD SCREW (196 affected)
summary: DUCATI IS RECALLING CERTAIN MODEL YEAR 2010 MULTISTRADA 1200 MOTORCYCLES.  DURING PRODUCTION AN INCORRECT SCREW MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE MOTORCYCLE'S STEERING HEAD.  THIS SITUATION COULD CAUSE THE STEERING HEAD TO POSSIBLY BECOME LOOSE DURING NORMAL OPERATION.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: HEADLAMP HEIGHT (16 affected)
summary: DAIMLER TRUCKS IS RECALLING CERTAIN MODEL YEAR 2011 BUSINESS CLASS M2 106V TRUCKS MANUFACTURED FROM APRIL 12, 2010 THROUGH JULY 16, 2010, FOR FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "'LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THESE TRUCKS MAY HAVE HEADLIGHTS WHICH MEASURE GREATER THAN 54" FROM THE ROAD SURFACE.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: 39 INCH THREE PASSENGER SEATS (516 affected)

title: Forest River, Inc.: TIRE & LOADING INFORMATION LABEL (155 affected)

AS A RESULT, THE GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING LABEL AND THE TIRE LABEL ON THE VEHICLES IS INCORRECT AND MAY LEAD AN OWNER TO INADVERTENTLY OVERLOAD THE VEHICLE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): GEAR SELECTOR (585 affected)

DURING ASSEMBLY PROCESS, THE CABLE THAT CONNECTS THE SHIFT LEVER TO THE TRANSMISSION WAS NOT SET CORRECTLY AT THE SHIFT LEVER BRACKET.  AS A RESULT THE DRIVER MAY MOVE THE GEAR SHIFT LEVER BUT THE TRANSMISSION MAY NOT BE PLACED IN THE SELECTED GEAR.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): IGNITION INTERLOCK (551,498 affected)

title: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: FRONT SIDE REFLECTOR HEIGHT (53,449 affected)

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: FRONT TURN SIGNAL GRILLS (3,552 affected)

title: BAD BOY ENTERPRISES, LLC: REAR DIFFERENTAL SUPPORT BRACKET/STEERING (16 affected)

title: EL DORADO R.V. INC.: INCORRECT WHEEL WELL PROFILE CUTOUT (246 affected)

title: NATIONAL SEATING COMPANY: DRIVER SEATS (3,892 affected)

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): INCORRECT GAWR LABEL (3,184 affected)

title: Mazda Motor Corp.: LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST (215,000 affected)

title: General Motors, LLC: SECOND ROW SAFETY BELT INTERFERENCE (207,210 affected)

THE SECOND ROW SEAT SIDE TRIM SHIELD RESTRICTS THE UPWARD ROTATION OF THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE WHEN THE SEAT BACK IS RETURNED TO A SEATING POSITION AFTER BEING FOLDED FLAT.  IF THE BUCKLE CONTACTS THE SEAT FRAME, ADDITIONAL EFFORT IS REQUIRED TO RETURN THE SEAT TO A SEATING POSITION.  IF SUFFICIENT FORCE IS APPLIED, THE BUCKLE COVER COULD BE PUSHED DOWN THE STRAP, EXPOSING AND PARTIALLY DEPRESSING THE RED RELEASE BUTTON.

title: WEBASTO PRODUCT NORTH AMERICA, INC.: SUNROOF SEPARATION (292,867 affected)
summary: WEBASTO IS RECALLING CERTAIN HOLLANDIA 700 AND 600 SERIES AND HOLLANDIA TVS 900 SERIES SUNROOFS SOLD AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR VARIOUS PASSENGER VEHICLES. COMPLETE GLASS-TO-FRAME DEBONDING CAN DEVELOP GRADUALLY AND MAY BE EVIDENCED BY METAL CORROSION AROUND THE SUNROOF FRAME, WIND NOISE, VIBRATION, VISUAL BOND SEPARATION AND/OR WATER LEAKAGE. THESE CONDITIONS MAY BE OBSERVABLE FOR SEVERAL MONTHS BEFORE COMPLETE GLASS-TO-FRAME ADHESION DEBONDING CAN ULTIMATELY OCCUR.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STARTER CABLE RETAINING NUT AND FLAT WASHER (3,992 affected)
